text: certainly, in vain made he it, the pen of the scribes is in vain: Or, the false pen of the scribes worketh for falsehood
The wise men are ashamed: Or, have they been ashamed, etc. | what wisdom is in them? Heb. the wisdom of what thing
I will surely consume them: Or, in gathering I will consume
all that is in it: Heb. the fullness thereof
because of them that dwell in a far country: Heb. because of the country of them that are far off
